# AGOT: The Long Night & Azor Ahai -- GENERATED by ln-audit-tools/gen_ln_rules.py.
# AGOT's can_move_domicile, taken verbatim from their common/scripted_rules/00_rules.txt (0.5.1),
# with the First Ranger clause widened to our ranging companies. Do not hand-edit: regenerate after every AGOT update so their
# changes to the rest of the rule flow straight through.
#
can_move_domicile = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { exists = county } #This will exclude sea provinces, impassable provinces, river provinces, etc
		save_temporary_scope_as = province_temp
		scope:owner.domicile ?= {
			# Estate
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_domicile_type = estate
						is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate
						is_domicile_type = japanese_manor
					}
				}
				# Cannot move estate outside top_liege realm
				scope:province_temp.county.holder.top_liege ?= {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = can_move_domicile_estate_realm_tt
						this = scope:owner.top_liege
					}
				}
				# Cannot move estate during war impacting location or destination
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = can_move_domicile_estate_war_tt
					scope:owner.domicile.domicile_location.county.holder ?= {
						NOR = {
							is_at_war = yes
							any_liege_or_above = { is_at_war = yes }
						}
					}
					scope:province_temp.county.holder ?= {
						NOR = {
							is_at_war = yes
							any_liege_or_above = { is_at_war = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				# Cannot move estate to its current location
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = can_move_domicile_estate_same_location_tt
					scope:owner.domicile.domicile_location != scope:province_temp
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_domicile_type = camp }
				# Cannot move domicile to places you've been exiled from.
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = can_move_domicile_camp_exile.tt
					NOT = {
						is_laamp_exiled_from_province_trigger = {
							PROVINCE = scope:province_temp
							LAAMP = scope:owner
						}
					}
				}
				scope:owner = { has_raised_armies = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { scope:owner = { is_ai = yes } }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:owner.culture = { agot_is_wildling_culture = no } }
						scope:province_temp = {
							NOT = { geographical_region = world_westeros_beyond_the_wall }
						}
					}
					trigger_else = {
						scope:province_temp = {
							geographical_region = world_westeros_wilding_raiding_zone
						}
					}
				}
			}
			#AGOT Added: agot_ranger_camp
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_domicile_type = agot_ranger_camp }
				# Cannot move domicile south of the wall.
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = can_move_domicile_agot_ranger_south.tt
					scope:province_temp ?= {
						OR = {
							geographical_region = world_westeros_the_wall
							geographical_region = world_westeros_beyond_the_wall
						}
					}
					# AGOT's line was:  scope:owner = title:d_nw_landless_first_ranger.holder
					#
					# THIS IS WHY THE RANGING CAMP COULD NOT MOVE -- MPREG's report and Thomas's own reproduction, and it
					# was never the provisions. Moving a camp is gated by this rule, and AGOT's clause asks not "are you a
					# landless brother of the Watch" but "are you THE First Ranger". Exactly one man in the world passes it;
					# our eight captains never could, so the engine's own Move Camp button was disabled for them permanently.
					#
					# Their First Ranger still passes through the first clause, byte for byte. The second lets a captain of
					# one of this mod's ranging companies move his own camp on the same terms -- the Wall and beyond it,
					# never south, never with armies raised. That IS the First Ranger's rule; we widen WHO it applies to.
					OR = {
						scope:owner = title:d_nw_landless_first_ranger.holder
						scope:owner = { any_held_title = { has_variable = ln_is_a_ranger_title } }
					}
				}
				scope:owner = { has_raised_armies = no }
			}
			#AGOT Added: agot_pirate_ship
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_domicile_type = agot_pirate_ship }
				scope:owner = { is_landed = no }
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = move_pirate_domicile_rules_tt
					scope:province_temp = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								is_coastal = yes
								has_building_or_higher = pirate_den_01
							}
							AND = {
								scope:province_temp = { geographical_region = historical_pirate_region }
								scope:province_temp = {
									OR = {
										has_holding_type = wilderness_holding
										has_holding_type = settlement_holding
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else = { exists = county } #This will exclude sea provinces, impassable provinces, river provinces, etc
}
